<!-- Write the title and body in English. Follow https://github.com/takahirox/WebXR-emulator-extension/blob/dev/docs/development-flow.md and target dev by default. -->

## Summary

Explain the source problem and the focused changes that address it.

## Outcome

Describe the resulting behavior, including a before/after example when useful. For intentionally partial implementation, state the remaining scope and leave the parent Issue open.

## Validation

List checks actually performed and their results. Report failures, skipped checks, and unperformed checks with reasons. Choose checks appropriate to the changed files and available repository tooling; documentation-only changes need Markdown/template syntax, link, whitespace, and consistency checks, without unrelated runtime or device testing.

## Related Issues

Link the source Issue and any related Issues. Use and preserve `Closes #<number>` when the PR fully implements the Issue and satisfies applicable mandatory pre-merge acceptance. Pending post-merge-only verification does not make complete implementation partial or require removing this reference. Use a non-closing reference for partial work.

## Required post-merge verification

None, unless the source Issue requires checks possible only after merge. List those checks separately as pending until performed; pre-merge validation does not prove deployment or publication succeeded. After merge and Issue closure, record results and any linked defect Issues following the [post-merge lifecycle](https://github.com/takahirox/WebXR-emulator-extension/blob/dev/docs/development-flow.md#6-perform-required-post-merge-verification).
